column1: # French (fr) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#                                 the French forms "one|other" (0 and 1 take the singular), see
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# French computing vocabulary (calque, sélection, pinceau, dégradé, flou, opacité ...). No
# proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; in
# particular not the French localisation of Adobe Photoshop. Add entries the same way.
# Conventions: menus are nouns (Fichier, Édition, Image ...), commands are infinitives (Ouvrir…,
# Enregistrer sous…), sentence case. French typography: a no-break space (U+00A0) before
# « : ; ? ! » and "%", and inside guillemets « … ». Product and technology names (PhotoCraft,
# ArtCraft, OpenType, Lab ...) stay as they are; RGB/CMYK read RVB/CMJN; the trailing "…" of
# Layer Mask Display Options (the layer mask rubylith's colour and opacity)
# Channel Options and New Spot Channel (#3761)
# Gradient Editor window, opened from the options bar's gradient swatch.
# Copy transforms, layer navigation and cancellable opening (from PR #582 by neko233-com).
# Labels added on main after this catalog (depth labels, Wayland drop, profiles, rendering mode)
# Camera Raw scopes and the Patch tool
# Shared screen eyedropper and text Color Picker (#1128).
# Fill dialog, layer style contours and Image Size
# File Info ▸ Camera Data (read-only EXIF fields; "Make" is the camera maker, not the verb).
# Select and Mask Refine Edge Brush (#2972)
# Color Sampler (added with the i18n coverage repair)
# Actions panel: Load/Save Actions (.atn) and kept Photoshop steps
# Actions panel: set folders, dialog toggle, Insert Stop
# Embedded Profile Mismatch: profile names beside the choices, Remember this choice
# Free Transform: a new layer while the box is open (#5859)
# Preferences › Performance › GPU Memory; the status bar and slow-redraw notice
# Actions: a step dialog holds a suspended recording (#7365)
# Color panel menu: modes, copy commands and colour ramps (#6000)
# Pen draft after a refused commit (#7648)
